name: Outdated cryptography library (pypi)
description: Python cryptography package below 41.0.0 lacks modern cipher enforcement and has multiple known CVEs affecting TLS and certificate handling.
rationale: NIST SC-8 and SC-13 require protected transmission and approved cryptographic protection. CIS v8 3.10 requires encryption of data in transit. PCI DSS 4.2.1/4.2.2 require strong cryptography over public networks and trusted certificate chains. An outdated cryptography library cannot reliably enforce these.
